title: Introducing: Composite Document Layouts
summary: This video introduces composite layouts for document reports in Business Central 2026 release wave 2. A report layout is split into a body layout (structure only), a theme (colors and fonts) and a header footer layout, which are combined at runtime. The presenter shows how to apply them on a single layout, how defaults cascade from global to company to report to layout, and how to add your own themes and header footer layouts in the app or from AL. A customer statement demo shows one body layout combined with different themes and header footers. The video ends with rollout options (a feature management switch and layout states) and a pointer to the developer documentation.

features.name: Composite layouts
features.description: The old all-in-one report layout is split into a body layout (structure), a theme (look and feel) and a header footer layout. Theme and header footer are applied at runtime, so the same report can be run in different ways.
caveats: The presenter says you can turn it off, at least for now.

features.name: Report themes and header footer layouts for reusable branding
features.description: Branding such as colors and fonts, and the header and footer content, is defined once as a theme or header footer layout and reused across document reports.

features.name: Composite layout menu on a body layout
features.description: On a body layout in the report layouts page, a composite layout menu lets you choose the report theme and header footer for testing. Running the report afterwards shows the header footer and the chosen theme (the calm theme in the example).
caveats: Without a theme and header footer applied, the raw body layout renders with no header and no styling.
prerequisites: A body layout set up to take a header footer and a theme

features.name: Default theme and header footer at global, company, report and layout level
features.description: You can set default theme and header footer globally, per company, per report and per body layout. Each lower level overrides the one above it.

features.name: Managed themes and header footer layouts page
features.description: In the app you can create a new theme or header footer layout from the managed themes and header footer layouts page. You give it a name and a description, and either create a blank layout or upload an existing one.

features.name: Adding themes and header footer layouts from AL
features.description: In the rendering section of a report you specify type Word and subtype Theme for a theme, or subtype Header Footer for a header footer layout. Body layouts use subtype Body. Themes use a Word template file.

features.name: Shipped themes, header footers and body layouts
features.description: Microsoft aims to ship three themes, about eight header footer layouts and around 50 body layouts across functional areas. The themes are calm, default, playful and standard. Header footers are split into external (with logo) and internal (minimal) reports. Samples are available for your own report objects.
features.status_evidence_quote: we aim to ship in version 20.9 and 20.1 and send 20.9.1
caveats: Version numbers are as heard and may be mangled by the captions.
The numbers are approximate (give or take).
The shipped set is mainly meant for trying it out at the start.

features.name: Mix and match themes and header footers on one body layout
features.description: The customer statement is shown with the old layout next to the new body layout, then with different themes and different header footers on the same body layout. One body, three themes and about eight header footers give many combinations.

features.name: Feature management switch for the new document experience
features.description: Feature management has a setting to enable or turn off the new document experience, so you can roll out composite layouts gradually per environment. The presenter finds it by semantic search in advanced Tell Me.
caveats: Default states of shipped layouts are not changed in version 2026, so invoices do not suddenly look different after the upgrade.

features.name: Layout state for shipped layouts (retired or draft)
features.description: You can set the state of layouts that Microsoft ships to retired or draft. A layout set this way does not show on the request page and only appears on the report layout page. The presenter says this is covered in a separate video.
caveats: Covered in more detail in a different video.
